trials.claim: Tier 1 offers lifetime access to Vocable AI for $89 (was $360)
trials.claimQuote:
License Tier 1: $89 (was $360)
- Lifetime access to Vocable AI
trials.reasoning: E1 only shows ordinary subscriptions auto-renew, which the rules say is not evidence against a deal-specific lifetime offer, and no exhibit confirms the $89 lifetime price.

exhibits.quote: Vocable offers subscription plans with recurring billing. Payments are processed through Stripe. All Vocable subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled prior to the renewal date.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows the vendor sells recurring subscriptions that auto-renew, contradicting a one-time $89 lifetime access claim.

trials.claim: Tier 3 includes unlimited brand voices and unlimited campaigns
trials.claimQuote:
Unlimited Brand voices
- Unlimited AI-powered campaigns
- 3 Additional seats
- MCP
- AI-powered content planning
- AI templates
- AI-generated drafts
- Keyword research
trials.reasoning: E2 is a generic termination clause and E3 is one user asking how to switch brands; neither directly shows Tier 3 lacks unlimited brand voices or campaigns, and no supporting exhibit is provided.

exhibits.quote: Vocable may suspend or terminate your account if you breach these Terms, fail to pay fees, or engage in fraudulent activities.
exhibits.argument: Unlimited Tier 3 access is undermined because the vendor reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts for fees or breach.

exhibits.quote: Where do I select my brand or switch between brands? (Also in the "Plan" view and in the dashboard)
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports inability to select or switch brands, contradicting the promise of unlimited brand voices working as advertised.

trials.claim: Tier 1 includes 1 brand voice and 2 AI-powered campaigns
trials.claimQuote:
Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into any new features and feature limits
- 1 Brand voices
- 2 AI-powered campaigns
- 0 Additional seats
trials.reasoning: E4 and E5 report broken templates and a network error, but neither shows Tier 1 was denied 1 brand voice or 2 campaigns as claimed.

exhibits.quote: Many templates (e.g. email sequences) do not work.
exhibits.argument: Tier 1 promise of included campaigns/templates is undermined by buyer reporting templates do not work.

exhibits.quote: I cannot generate any content due to a "Network error" coming from the platform itself.
exhibits.argument: Claim of 2 AI-powered campaigns included is contradicted by buyer unable to generate any content at all due to platform error.

trials.claim: Tier 2 includes 5 brand voices and 5 AI-powered campaigns
trials.claimQuote:
Previous AppSumo customers will be grandfathered into any new features and feature limits
- 5 Brand voices
- 5 AI-powered campaigns
- 0 Additional seats
trials.reasoning: E6 is a single review saying an upgrade changed nothing, which alone is too weak to outweigh the Tier 2 listing or prove the 5 voices and 5 campaigns were not included.

exhibits.quote: After upgrading from Tier 1, nothing has changed at all.
exhibits.argument: Tier 2 promise of 5 brand voices and 5 campaigns is contradicted by buyer reporting upgrade produced no change in features.

trials.claim: Includes all future Basic or Pro Plan updates
trials.claimQuote: All future Basic (Tier 1) or Pro (Tier 2-3) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: E7 only says the vendor may update its terms, not that future Basic or Pro plan updates will be withheld, and no exhibit confirms the update promise.

exhibits.quote: Vocable may update these Terms at any time. We will notify users of material changes via email or platform notifications.
exhibits.argument: Promise of all future updates is undermined because vendor can unilaterally change terms at any time.

trials.claim: Generate 30 days of content in one click
trials.claimQuote: Generate 30 days of content in one click
trials.reasoning: Users report being unable to generate any content due to a platform network error and receiving largely fabricated output, directly undercutting the vendor marketing in E10 and E11 that one click generates 30 days of ready content.

exhibits.quote: I cannot generate any content due to a "Network error" coming from the platform itself.
exhibits.argument: One-click 30-day generation claim is contradicted by buyer reporting complete inability to generate any content due to platform network error.

exhibits.quote: the articles are 99% made up nonsense. It's actually impressive how detailed the nonsense gets too.
exhibits.argument: Claim of instant ready-to-review content is undermined by buyer reporting output is 99% fabricated nonsense requiring heavy correction.

exhibits.quote: Plan and Generate 30 Days of Multi-Channel Content With One Click
exhibits.argument: This vendor headline directly states the one-click 30-day generation claim.

exhibits.quote: One click generates 30 days of content, organized into a content plan with ready-to-review posts.
exhibits.argument: This vendor description confirms one click produces 30 days of content as claimed.
